published_prior_art.cite: FangRidderXie2026: benchmark-penalized policy regret has a quadratic fixed-dimensional limit, but not this Gaussian-null identity.
CandesSur2020: sharp Gaussian logistic-MLE separation transition, not pooled-target entropy-balance feasibility.
LuYangWang2025: proportional randomized-trial regression-adjustment decomposition, not same-sample exponential entropy tilts.
FangRidderXie2026 proves the fixed-policy-dimension estimated-propensity result; SurCandes2019 and ThrampoulidisAbbasiHassibi2018 analyze single-estimator proportional systems.
SurCandes2019 gives proportional logistic-MLE state inference, not inference for certified branches of dependent entropy-tilt and policy optimizers.
HiranoImbensRidder2003 and FangRidderXie2026 establish the relevant fixed-dimensional efficiency mechanism, though not these calibration constants.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 (radial invariance)
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed gamma-invariance of the entire true-propensity criterion is false: conditional on q, 2 S Y has variance 4 m(q), and m(q)=sigma(gamma q_1) varies with gamma whenever sigma(q^T beta)-1/2 is nonzero.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4 gives sqrt(n)(theta-hat^ep-theta*) converging to G and nR converging to G^T H G/2; its proof uses K/n=o(1) and explicitly invokes fixed dimension of theta.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Appendix E, 'CLT of quadratic forms and asymptotic normality when p is of the same order as n'; Appendix F, inference
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies a debiased regression-adjustment estimator in completely randomized experiments with p of the same order as n, deriving asymptotic normality and an inference procedure.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1804.09753v1, corresponding preprint for Annals of Statistics 48 (2020)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The result is a sharp proportional Gaussian logistic-MLE existence phase transition, with existence and nonexistence separated by an explicit boundary curve.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Delete the false full-function gamma-invariance clause from Proposition 1, retain the exact radial-regret identity, and explicitly carry the gamma-dependent true-propensity noise into every downstream state equation.
Make the joint-system output a concrete finite equation list before the inference theorem is retained, including the branch-selection objective and the derivatives used by the covariance formula.
Add a non-null-effect calibration or a formally stated transfer result tying the phase label to a genuine policy-value decision, rather than relying only on the arm-invariant null benchmark.

recommended_next_step: Revise Proposition 1 and all downstream uses of its false gamma-invariance claim; then retain the field-grade joint-system question for Stage 0.
